claude_proposed_widenings.name: reduce_damage_taken
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item's primary deterministic effect is a reaction that subtracts a rolled amount plus Dexterity modifier from incoming damage. No existing effect atom models reducing damage already being dealt.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can take a Reaction to reduce the damage by 1d10 plus your Dexterity modifier

claude_proposed_widenings.name: weapon_filter.thrown
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The reaction trigger grammar can narrow to weapon_category=ranged, but it cannot express the SRD trigger's explicit union of ranged weapons and thrown weapons.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: hit by an attack roll made with a Ranged or Thrown weapon

claude_proposed_widenings.name: activation_requirement.free_hand
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The reaction is only available when the wearer has a free hand. Existing activated-ability mechanics have no requirement/predicate field for this precondition.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: if you have a free hand
